scenes.heading: Schemas
scenes.narration: A schema, also called a database, is the middle layer of Unity Catalog that groups related tables and views inside a catalog.

scenes.heading: What a schema does
scenes.narration: A schema logically groups tables and views that belong together, like all CRM tables. It carries its own permissions so you can grant access at just that level. And it sits neatly between the catalog above and the tables below.

scenes.heading: Creating a schema
scenes.narration: Here we create a crm schema inside the main catalog with a helpful comment. We then create a Delta table fully qualified as main dot crm dot contacts. Organizing tables into schemas keeps a large catalog navigable and easy to govern.

scenes.text: Group tables into schemas by domain or lifecycle stage so permissions and discovery stay simple as data grows.
scenes.narration: Group your tables into schemas by domain or lifecycle stage, so that permissions and discovery stay simple as the data grows.
